div.style: color: rgb(255, 255, 255) !important; display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;

span.p:
Bjerrum length l_B = e^2/(4 pi eps0 epsr kB T)
= 7.1 A in water at 298 K

div.style: color: rgb(255, 255, 255) !important; display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;

span.p:
Manning parameter xi = l_B / b
b = AXIAL charge spacing (helix-axis projection)
NOT the P-P contour distance ~5.9-7.0 A

div.style: color: rgb(255, 255, 255) !important; display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;

span.p:
condensed fraction theta = 1 - 1/(z xi)
A-form RNA: b=1.40 A (AXIAL, not P-P contour)
xi = 5.11, theta = 0.804, q_eff = -0.196
the often-quoted 0.76 is the B-DNA figure

CAVEAT THAT MUST BE STATED
crystallographic Mg2+ are SITE-BOUND only.
The diffuse Manning atmosphere is invisible to
crystallography. The explicit head learns site
binding, NOT the atmosphere. Do not conflate.
